name: Chinese Chilli Pipe Style Fryums
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour {Maida (54%)}, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein Oil), Starch, Sugar, Iodized Salt, Soya Powder, Dehydrated Vegetable Powder (Garlic, Onion, Ginger), Spices & Condiments {Red Chilli Powder (1.4%), Cumin Powder, Turmeric Powder, Pepper Powder, Coriander Powder, Cinnamon Powder, Clove Powder}, Flavour Enhancer (INS 635), Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Flavour (Natural and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances) & Anticaking Agent (INS 551).
